verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves the prior major finding. The revised left- and right-boundary checks treat `-`, internal `.`, `%` escapes, PN_LOCAL escapes, and Unicode as name continuations only with the necessary prefixed-name context, while retaining a positive control for a genuine typo adjacent to `.`. The new `prefixed_names_with_punctuation_are_never_flagged` test validates all reported examples against the real vendored parser before asserting that hints are empty, so it is non-vacuous. The bounded scans also conservatively prevent adversarial punctuation runs from causing quadratic work. I found no remaining correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff.
